name: saldo360
description: Atalhos para rodar o Saldo360 localmente: PostgreSQL no Docker, API e frontend na máquina, login pelo Authelia do servidor (ou por um Authelia local opcional).

scripts.setup: npm run setup:tools && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:migrate: dotnet ef database update -p src/Saldo360.Infrastructure -s src/Saldo360.Api -- --environment Development
scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && npm run db:migrate && npm start
scripts.dev:authelia-local: npm run docker:up:authelia-local && npm run db:migrate && npm run start:authelia-local
scripts.build: dotnet build Saldo360.slnx && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run lint
